programme.title: Top of Coit Tower
programme.desc: One day, X shows up at Mike's house. X attacks Mike with Crying Man and tries to take all the Hero Books, while Mike uses Sylph to bring back Crying Man's Hero Book.

programme.title: Revolution
programme.desc: Lucy explains to Mike that Scott who created the Hero Books is her uncle and that she's collecting the Hero Books to find clues to her missing uncle.

programme.desc: The battle between Dirk O's gang versus Mike and X breaks out, and with Diro O's overwhelming power, the entire city is in danger.

programme.title: Strawberry On The Air
programme.desc: Mike and Lucy become a team through Season 1. They rescue a plane crashing into the sea in front of the city and show the abilities as a new team as heroes.

programme.title: Criminals and Chameleon
programme.desc: Mike and Lucy defeat the villains who use Chameli with the ability of a chameleon to commit crimes. However, the police and citizens treat all Hero Book Readers as criminals.

programme.desc: Tara interviews Super Awesome Man and X through Nick. Mike tries his best not to get caught by Tara. Meanwhile, Mike's group chasing Chameli runs into Christa and Timo.

programme.desc: The Council of Comics, stealing the 25 Cent's Hero Book from bank robbers, gather to create Nerd-utopia at their hideout, Papa Princess's house.

programme.desc: Chasing after Super Scott's Hero Book through the city, the main characters finally encounter Super Scott on a giant suspension bridge.
